purpose: Realistic AI visualisations of completed buildings and cleared construction materials, based on the existing project images.
resolutionNote: The built-in ImageGen tool returned native images below Full HD despite requested higher dimensions. Full HD delivery files are Lanczos-resampled exports of those AI-restored images, not native 4K or new detail produced by scaling. Native outputs are retained under source/.
encoding: Lossless WebP full-size files and transparent layers; opaque 640/960/1280px responsive variants use WebP quality 96.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: high-resolution realistic residential colony website photograph. Edit target: the attached River Green image. Create a meticulous photographic restoration with genuinely resolved fine detail, smooth clean edges, natural sharpness and rich realistic daylight. Remove all visible construction clutter: loose or stacked bricks, rubble, broken concrete, cement bags, sand or aggregate piles, scrap, construction tools and unfinished debris. Restore the cleared surfaces with matching paving, soil or existing lawn as appropriate. Finish every existing incomplete house/building within its exact original footprint and height, with understated off-white plastered walls, finished roof edges, realistic windows, doors and simple railings matching this low-rise neighbourhood. Do not create houses in empty plots. Preserve the camera, full framing, road and plot layout, entrance gate, exact 'River Green' lettering, fountain shape and water on/off state, existing gardens, palms, benches, lampposts, people and ordinary vehicles. Keep utilities unless directly part of construction debris. Reconstruct credible fine stone grain, individual leaf detail, water droplets, paving seams and straight architectural edges. Preserve believable surface texture rather than smoothing surfaces into plastic. Avoid blurry pixels, compression blocks, ringing, jagged edges, smeared foliage, duplicate objects, halos, fake HDR, illustration and cartoon/CGI appearance. No logos, text overlays, frames or watermarks. Scene-specific request: finish the unfinished two-storey house on the left with realistic cream plaster, finished windows and doors and a completed terrace edge. Preserve its footprint and height. Output a genuinely detailed 3072 x 2304 pixel 4:3 image; not a stretched low-resolution bitmap.
